title: I gave AI one sentence… and it built this website. #ai #shorts #aivideo #gemini #shortvideo
description:
I gave Gemini one prompt... and it built a working website. 🤯

Using Google AI Studio's Build mode, you can describe what you want in plain English and Gemini can generate a working app with a live preview, including the interface and code behind it.

In this video, we test how far you can take that idea:

IDEA → PROMPT → CODE → WORKING APP

No traditional coding required for the initial build.

You describe it.
AI builds it.
NodeShift.exe_
